definitions.short: to smoke , whether literal or figurative
definitions.full: H6225. ashan עָשַׁן verb denominative smoke, be wroth ; — Qal 1. a. smoke , Perfect 3masculine singular ׳ע of mountain Exod 19:18 , so Imperfect 3masculine plural יֶעֱשָׁ֑נוּ (at touch of ׳י ) Psa 104:32 ; 144:5 . b. figurative, 3 masculine singular אַףיֿ ׳יֶעְשַׁן , with ב against , Deut 20:19 ; Psa 74:1 . Hence 2 subject person, fume , i.e. be wroth, Perfect 2masculine singular בּ ׳עָשַׁנְתָּ Psa 80:5 .
